messages:
amy (sales): Hey team — Observa wants to start a 30d POC next week. They sent a SIG/CAIQ + their own vendor questionnaire. Can eng-security fast-track?

maria (eng-security): Sending the docs to review now. Quick Q: will the POC touch customer data or just synthetic?

amy (sales): POC will ingest anonymized logs and metadata only. No PII. We asked them to accept a data-minimization addendum.

kyle (solutions): For the POC we only need API access and an S3 bucket with redacted logs. No inbound networking expected.

maria (eng-security): Got it. I'll map their SIG/CAIQ to our controls. Initial concerns: persistence duration unclear, and they haven't provided proof of encryption-at-rest key management.

devsec-bot: Automated scan result: Observa doc set received (sig-caiq-2026.pdf). Missing artifacts flagged: SOC2 report, pen-test summary, KMS policy.

maria (eng-security): @amy can you ask them for: SOC2 Type II (last 12 months), pen test summary, network diagram, KMS/HSM details, data retention SLA, and their vulnerability disclosure policy. Also we need to confirm they support customer-managed keys for S3.

amy (sales): pinged them — expect answers in 24h. Also asked about enterprise pricing for when we go beyond POC.

oliver (legal): If they're asking for VPC peering we need infra review. Also any long-term contract must include right-to-audit and subprocessor list.

jess (eng-ml): Quick technical note — for latency tests we'll use a small model shard and sample traffic. We need an IP allowlist for the test runners.

maria (eng-security): Minimal access plan for the POC:
1) Read-only API key scoped to project
2) One S3 prefix with lifecycle to auto-delete after 30 days
3) IP allowlist for our egress

kyle (solutions): I'll prepare the S3 and an IAM role. Example policy we can use:

```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":"s3:GetObject","Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::redwood-poc/observa/*"}
  ]
}
```

amy (sales): Observa replied: SOC2 in progress (expected in 6 wks), they provided pen-test summary (low findings), and they support SSE-KMS but not customer-managed keys right now. They offered a temporary solution: rotate keys daily and provide audit logs.

maria (eng-security): If SOC2 is pending that's a risk for enterprise deals. For POC OK if we limit data to synthetic and enforce TTL. Need pen-test report to verify scope and remediation timeline.

devsec-bot: Pen-test attachment scanned: low/medium items listed. One medium issue: service account credentials with long TTL. Recommendation: reduce credential lifetime to <24h and enable MFA for the admin console.

oliver (legal): We can accept a POC while SOC2 is pending if contract has explicit limitations and no production data allowed. Also add clause: right to suspend access on security findings.

amy (sales): Pricing note from Observa: POC free for 30d, then list starts at $95k/yr for reserved throughput. Sales ask: can we offer a template concession: internal POC credit + pilot pricing?

kyle (solutions): From infra POV reserved throughput pricing is OK to negotiate. For the POC we should insist on limited retention and no KMS exceptions.

maria (eng-security): Proposed acceptance conditions for POC (short):
- Synthetic-only dataset
- Data TTL <= 30 days and auto-delete enforced
- Read-only API key with scoped permissions and rotation <24h
- Pen-test report reviewed, medium items remediated or mitigated
- Audit log access for POC window

amy (sales): I'll push that. They also asked if we can sign their standard vendor NDA — legal?

oliver (legal): Send me the NDA, I'd prefer to redline for right-to-audit and subprocessor transparency.

jess (eng-ml): Small ask: can Observa provide a simple endpoint for warmup so model cache priming doesn't skew latency numbers? e.g., POST /health/warm with a sample payload.

Observa (external): @amy thanks — we can provide that endpoint and daily key rotation. SOC2 ETA 6 weeks. We'll send KMS architecture diagram and pen-test report now.

amy (sales): They uploaded diagrams + pen-test — forwarding to @maria and @devsec-bot.

maria (eng-security): Reviewing the pen-test now. Topline: low risk, one medium (credential TTL) — they committed to fix in 7 days. For the KMS diagram: they use managed keys; no external HSM. We need to flag lack of CMK.

devsec-bot: Auto-check: CMK support: NO. Recommended mitigations acknowledged by vendor: daily rotation, encrypted-at-rest with AWS-managed KMS, audit logs forwarded to SIEM.

maria (eng-security): Given mitigations and limited POC scope I'm comfortable approving POC with the conditions above. I'll draft a short security addendum for the POC.

amy (sales): Amazing — thank you. Timeline: legal + sec signoff by EOD Friday?

oliver (legal): I'll put NDA + POC addendum on DocuSign today. Expect redline within 24h.

kyle (solutions): Marking infra tasks: create S3 prefix, IAM role, IP allowlist. I'll post configs when ready. :thumbsup:

amy (sales): Thanks all. If anything blocks rollout to the customer post-POC we'll escalate.

maria (eng-security): One follow-up item: after POC we MUST re-evaluate before any production contract if Observa still lacks SOC2 or CMK.

amy (sales): noted. Closing here for now — will update when NDA + addendum signed. :white_check_mark:
